scope: Read-only applicability review of the three published WP10 Planner calculation files against the exact first ScenarioComparisonInput preparation that failed in WP12 W20. This is not a complete security approval or runtime performance verdict on those files.

observed_failure.firstFailingPhase: First HTTP analysis prepare after all three C09 alternatives were prepared.
observed_failure.causeLimit: The log does not identify an inner refusal or prove the cause of the approximately 300-second prepare interval. No improved duration is inferred from this source review.

changedEntryPoints: historical reader receives a current Planner record verifier
files.limit: verifyCalculationSources has the same public signature and same decision body. The replay-loader wrappers only observe an already-active calculation frame.

changedEntryPoints: historical calculation resolve → UI Planner record verification callback
files.limit: resolve begins by requiring kind=calculation, Planner engine identity and record-only ancestry; it additionally requires a protected historical capture and selected ledger event.
Invoked by issueObserved; merely instantiating this factory in the host does not invoke its read scope.

pathEvidence.fact: The helper obtains three real Planner issueSource record references, drafts a case with those references, registers coverage using the same record references and promotes three scenarios with operations=[] and assumptions=[]. It does not call calculations.issue, cite calculation references, record a choice or create historical captures.

addAlternative calls the real Planner and coverage assessor, then saveCase writes an alternative and StoredDecisionResult whose sources come from the scenario result and its coverage. This branch does not append a ledger event, issue a calculation reference or call calculations.persist.

ScenarioComparisonInput calls cases.read, scenarioLookup twice, planner.compareScenarios, current source context, cases.read again and both lookups again. It does not issue or resolve a calculation reference directly.
The lookup selects persisted C09 result identity by case/alternative digests and reads it through readHistoricalScenario twice, with current case rereads.
The comparison resolver also uses readHistoricalScenario and current cases; its source proof is a Planner record reference and actual compareForecast of that reference against itself.

readHistoricalScenario invokes readResult(..., historical=true) without the calculation flag. Thus it uses the general source verifier and does not call verifyCalculationSources, readForCalculation or readHistoricalCalculation.

Case evidence collection visits actual source, coverage, alternative, choice and ledger references. This fixture's alternatives/coverage retain Planner record references, operations/assumptions are empty and draft/addAlternative leave choices/ledger empty. No calculation reference is introduced by the reader.

BCS routing dispatches record/planner/planner-version references to the Planner reader. Only kind=calculation dispatches to the calculation resolver, whose historical fallback is also calculation-specific.

The installed business service creates calculation services and passes its callbacks to the result store/Atlas. This establishes availability, but not invocation by record-only ScenarioComparisonInput. Its ordinary result verifySources callback uses current BCS references.

conclusions: The three files have real purposes for current/historical calculation evidence. They are not the modified path used by the observed record-only C09 scenario preparation.
No change in this trio replaces the repeated cases.read, lookup, stored-scenario source self-comparison, coverage validation or final analysis authority checks seen in this fixture.

No intake or new Scenarios run is recommended on the basis of this trio. The existing Scenarios HOLD and the distinction between the latent own comparison-scope correction and the observed first-prepare refusal remain unchanged.

An exact transitive dependency/security closure for activating these files was deliberately not completed after the applicability gate failed, as requested. The two diffs and full pinned source bytes are preserved for another calculation-specific task.

verification.method: Complete pinned source reads, static call graph and source-byte SHA-1/SHA-256 verification only.

limitations: This conclusion is scoped to the exact W20 fixture and first input preparation, not every ScenarioComparisonInput with arbitrary calculation/ledger evidence.
No runtime profiler or inner-stage timing was available in the observed log.
No inference, model availability or criterion is promoted by this audit.
